69:A [pi-durable](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-durable) extension adds its tools and prompt sections to every conversation: comment mode, `pr_number` runs, and direct prompts. An example is the `pit/durable` extension of [pit](https://github.com/cv/pit):
76:      github:cv/pit#v0.35.0   # pit's typescript tool (pit/durable)
112:`trust_project` (default `false`) tells the extension that it can load and run the configuration of the repository. For pit, this is `.pi/pit.json` and `.pi/functions`. pi-action uses it too: for the prompt templates in `.pi/prompts` and the skills in `.pi/skills` and `.agents/skills` (see [Security](security.md#skills-from-the-repository)).
123:| `model_tools_hidden` | pi-action does not offer these tools to the model. Other tools can still call them, for example pit's `tools.*` |
125:For example, to give the model only pit's `typescript` tool, and keep the coding tools available to its programs:
132:      github:cv/pit#v0.35.1
133:    model_tools_hidden: read, write, edit, bash
136:- Write one name per line, or separate names with commas. `*` matches any characters, as in pit's `allowedTools`. For example, `mcp_*`.
140:- The `🤖` line of the log shows the tools that the model gets, for example `🤖 anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 · tools: typescript · extensions: pit (typescript)`.
146:A tool can ask its user a question with `ui.confirm`, `ui.select`, or `ui.input`. (pit asks with its `ui.*` globals, and also when it promotes a function to the project.) pi-action posts the question as a comment on the issue or pull request, and **the run ends**. An answer starts a new run, which continues the thread.
152:1. The tool calls `ui.ask` of pi-action. pi-action posts the question and returns its URL immediately. pit stops the program (the calls that it made before the question keep their effects) and ends the turn with "Question posted: ...".
156:5. pi runs its step again. When the program asks the same question, pit returns the answer and does not ask again. Each answer is used one time. If the program asks the same question later, pi-action asks again.
162:| Kind | The comment | How to answer | The value pit gets |
